runner: NUC over Tailscale, systemd user scope
result: For the actual lazy-oracle query transition, a second fresh input may depend on the first answer while the two returned answers still have exact joint target mass 1/card(Block)^2. The actual unread-tape cursor advances by exactly two. A source-facing theorem instantiates this law for the literal digest||1 and digest||2 squeeze inputs from any valid chronological prefix where both inputs are unseen.
scope_limit: The theorem requires both cache misses, expressed as old-prefix cache absence plus separation from the first input. It does not prove that the V8 OOD source inputs meet those premises, assemble four blocks into a QM31 point, or establish the complete sampler distribution.
